acceptance_criteria.summary: The scoped relock command `uv lock --upgrade-package cryptography` updated only the cryptography package version, from 48.0.1 to 49.0.0. A structured comparison against HEAD showed no other package version changes. The regenerated cryptography block has 39 wheels, including 12 Linux x86_64 wheels such as cp311-abi3 manylinux and cp314-cp314t manylinux artifacts.

The exact scoped audit command exited 0 and reported `No known vulnerabilities found`. The exported requirements included cryptography 49.0.0, idna 3.15, pydantic-settings 2.14.2, pyjwt 2.13.0, python-multipart 0.0.31, and starlette 1.3.1.
The complete non-integration suite passed with the scoped lockfile: 1427 passed, 23 deselected, 52 warnings. The explicit auth-adjacent suites also passed: 60 passed.

scope_changes: No source-code compatibility changes were needed.
python/uv.lock was updated by `uv lock --upgrade-package cryptography`; lockfile TOML was not hand-edited.
No unscoped `uv lock` or lockfile deletion was performed in this retry.

The only package version change detected in python/uv.lock was cryptography 48.0.1 to 49.0.0. uv also normalized one pydantic-settings upload-time timestamp without changing its URL, hash, size, or version; pydantic-settings is one of the six in-scope packages.
downstream_impacts: Frozen Linux installs no longer need to build cryptography from sdist because the lock includes manylinux and musllinux x86_64 wheels for cryptography 49.0.0.
The scoped audit confirms cryptography 49.0.0 has no known vulnerabilities in the exported requirements set.
Auth and API-key authentication paths were exercised after the cryptography relock with no regressions.
reconciliation_note: This retry supersedes the discarded unscoped relock evidence. The actual fix command was `cd python && uv lock --upgrade-package cryptography`, which resolved cryptography 49.0.0 and produced the full cross-platform wheel set while leaving all other package versions unchanged.
